## Safety Notes

- Credential behavior: No credentials are required by the skill body. GitHub CLI authentication was used only by the installer after anonymous clone rate limits; tokens remain local and uncommitted.
- Network access: No network behavior is required by default after installation. Any OpenSpec CLI or repository operations remain explicit user-directed local commands.
- File access: Reads and writes OpenSpec proposal, design, spec, task, and test artifacts only when explicitly invoked for a user-selected change.
- Live action risk: Overlaps repo-native OpenSpec workflows and can move, archive, or generate project files; require explicit change selection, dry-run/review where available, and validation before destructive archive or broad implementation steps.
- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.
